name: flock
description: One language model split across your laptop and your phone

scripts.check: node check_html.mjs ../web/*.html && node --check src/server.js && node --check src/mesh.js && node --check src/coordinator.js && node --check src/gguf.mjs && node --check src/allocate.js && node --check src/speed.js && node --check ../web/js/probe.mjs && node --check sim_bird.mjs && node --check plan.mjs && node --check test/membership_e2e.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && node test/allocate.test.mjs && node test/flock.test.mjs && node test/probe.test.mjs && node test/gguf.test.mjs && node test/gguf_dir.test.mjs && node test/bird_gguf.test.mjs
scripts.cert: bash -c 'mkdir -p ../.certs && IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || echo 127.0.0.1) && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 825 -keyout ../.certs/key.pem -out ../.certs/cert.pem -subj /CN=flock -addext subjectAltName=IP:$IP,IP:127.0.0.1,DNS:localhost && echo "cert for $IP written to .certs/"'
